name: subagent
description: Delegate a self-contained sub-problem to a nested agent with its own context and a short iteration budget; returns its final answer. WHEN TO USE: work that would otherwise fill your own context — reading a large file to answer one question, checking a claim, drafting one patch — while you keep the thread of the main task. WHEN NOT TO USE: anything you can finish in a couple of tool calls yourself; delegation costs a whole extra run. The sub-agent starts with an EMPTY transcript: it cannot see what you have read or decided, so brief it. Put the facts it must not re-derive in "context" and the paths worth reading in "files" (it reads them itself, which costs you nothing). Input: {"task": "...", "context": ["..."], "files": ["src/x.zig"], "provider": "kimi-k3"}.

context.description: Facts, constraints and decisions you already established, so the sub-agent does not redo that work.

files.description: Paths the sub-agent should read first. Passed by reference; it reads them itself.
